name: deluluscan-dashboard
description: The Deluluscan security report UI. Built by Vite into ONE self-contained HTML file, vendored to deluluscan/assets/dashboard_bundle.html, into which deluluscan/dashboard.py injects the scan payload (plaintext, or AES-GCM encrypted behind a passphrase). Run ../scripts/build_dashboard.sh after changing anything here. The SecurityDashboard component tree under src/components/security is mirrored from target-aios/frontend and kept verified by src/test/dashboard.test.tsx.
